name: Kneringerhof
beschreibung: The family-run Kneringerhof enjoys a sunny and peaceful location in Serfaus on the sun-drenched Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis high plateau. The property offers spacious holiday apartments and rooms decorated with warm alpine woodwork. Private balconies afford breathtaking views across the Samnaun mountain peaks. Guests appreciate the tranquil edge-of-village setting surrounded by nature. Thanks to the Serfaus village subway, modern ski lifts and village amenities are reachable within minutes, making it a fantastic year-round haven for families and outdoor explorers.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming alpine farmstay and family accommodation in Serfaus on the sunny high plateau.
